title: Granite Embedding Multilingual R2: Open Apache 2.0 Multilingual Embeddings with 32K Context — Best Sub-100M Retrieval Quality
brief: IBM released Granite Embedding Multilingual R2, an open-source multilingual embedding model under Apache 2.0 license with 32K context length and sub-100M parameters, achieving best-in-class retrieval quality for its size category. The model supports multiple languages and is designed for efficient deployment in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search applications.
